name: Kofin Sync Queue
overview: Typed change queue for the Kofin Kodi client
description: Companion plugin for plugin.video.kofin: records library and user-data changes as typed records (change reason, series/season parents), serves them with query-time Etags and an in-band retention cutoff, so offline Kodi boxes catch up with minimal traffic.

versions.changelog:
- Records carry the libraries they belong to, and the feed can be filtered
  to them, so a client no longer fetches changes from libraries it does not
  sync. Announced as "library-scope" in the Info response's Features list.
- Records left behind by a deleted library are reaped rather than served
  until the retention cutoff.
- Version numbers now track the Jellyfin ABI (10.11.x), so which server a
  build targets is readable from the version alone.
- Releases are built and drafted by CI, and announced to the Kontell
  repository on publish.
- The plugin catalogue shows these notes: meta.json carries the changelog
  the repository manifest has been serving empty until now.
